data.one_liner: A non-interactive HTML documentation generator for Dart source code.
data.what_it_does: Generates static HTML API documentation from Dart source code and documentation comments. It analyzes packages, processes tags like categories and macros, and produces navigable HTML output.
use_when: You need to generate offline-viewable API documentation for a Dart package
You want to produce standard HTML documentation for your Dart codebase
avoid_when: You need an interactive documentation viewer built into your application
You are looking for code generation for JSON parsing or data models
strengths: Supports advanced features like categories, macros, and external tools
weaknesses: Requires an HTTP server to fully view navigation and search locally
Requires package to analyze without errors before generating docs
data.setup_notes: Part of the Dart SDK; run via 'dart doc .'
